message: Hey Jane, just checking in. How's everything going at home? Heard there was some tension lately. Hope all is well. Let me know if you need to talk.
Sis, I'm really struggling with the situation at home. It's getting to me, and I don't know how to handle it.
Jane, please don't discuss Alex's issues with your friends. We need to keep this within the family.
I can't believe I finally graduated. I'm excited to start at Henderson Enterprises next week!
Congratulations on Alex's graduation! Must be a proud moment for you all :)
Thanks, Em! It's a relief he's done with school. Now just hoping he settles well into his new job.
Do you think I should talk to a professional about the family stuff? I'm at a loss.
Maybe that's a good idea, Alex. It might help to get an outside perspective.
I'm here if you need to vent. You know I'm always up for a coffee or a walk.
Appreciate it, Em. It's been tough, but we're managing. Catch up soon?
